result:
Online application already exists in this repo, with processes, form templates, the apply flow and letter requests. The one piece missing from the issue was letting the candidate choose the form language, so I'm adding that.

I added an `around_action` in `app/controllers/admissions/process_base_controller.rb`. It reads `params[:locale]` and remembers it in the session, then applies it with `I18n.with_locale`. Any locale not in `I18n.available_locales` falls back to the default. I also added language links to `app/views/admissions/admissions/index.html.erb`, shown only when more than one locale is available.

I haven't run the tests or loaded the pages, so this is untested. The repo only ships `pt-BR` translations, so the language links won't show until someone adds, for example, English locale files.
